ver_ficha_navigation.issue: Ver ficha link from Reincidentes tab navigated to /estudiantes/{id} without subdomain prefix, causing 404
ver_ficha_navigation.root_cause: Relative path '../estudiantes/' was resolving incorrectly from URL with query params
ver_ficha_navigation.fix: 1. Updated ReportesPage to pass subdomain prop to TabReincidentes component. 2. Changed navigation to use absolute path with subdomain. 3. Added route /:subdomain/coordinacion/estudiantes/:studentId in App.js. 4. Updated EstudiantesFichaPage to read studentId from URL params and auto-load ficha.
